org.mases.jcobridge.netreflection

Class NetGenericHelper

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.mases.jcobridge.netreflection.NetGenericHelper

  • public final class NetGenericHelper
extends java.lang.Object
    Helper for the generic classes that do not extend NetObject, such as the generic delegates.

    It offers the same logic used by NetObject: it reads the type arguments from the anonymous subclass of a generic class (new Foo<Bar>() {}), builds the name of the closed CLR type and instantiates the type arguments reflectively.

    • Method Detail

      • buildClosedClrName

        public static java.lang.String buildClosedClrName(java.lang.String openClrName,
                                                  java.lang.Class<?>[] typeArguments)
        Builds the name of a closed generic CLR type, for example System.Collections.Generic.List`1[System.Object]. The name of each type argument is read from its public static className field.
        Parameters:
        openClrName - the name of the open generic type, for example System.Collections.Generic.List`1
        typeArguments - the classes of the type arguments
        Returns:
        the name of the closed generic type
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if a type argument does not expose a public static className field

      • instantiate

        public static <X> X instantiate(java.lang.Class<?>[] typeArguments,
                                int index,
                                java.lang.Object nativeHandle)
                         throws java.lang.Throwable
        Reflectively builds an instance of a type argument, wrapping a native handle returned from the bridge. It uses the public constructor of the type argument that accepts a single Object.
        Type Parameters:
        X - the type of the instance to build
        Parameters:
        typeArguments - the classes of the type arguments
        index - the position of the type argument to instantiate
        nativeHandle - the native object returned from the bridge
        Returns:
        the new instance of the type argument
        Throws:
        java.lang.Throwable - if the type argument has no public constructor accepting a single Object, or if that constructor fails

      • resolveTypeArguments

        public static java.lang.Class<?>[] resolveTypeArguments(java.lang.Class<?> instanceClass)
        Returns the type arguments captured by the anonymous subclass, as in new Foo<Bar>() {}. The result is cached for each class.
        Parameters:
        instanceClass - the class of the instance: it must be an anonymous subclass of a generic class
        Returns:
        the classes of the type arguments, in declaration order
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the instance was not created with the anonymous subclass syntax, or if a type argument is not a plain class
